data.title: International Logix-compatible launch — five manufacturers and Aion Tech UK

actions.description: Accepted scenario: coordinated US, West German, French and Spanish premieres by North Star, Vector Graphic, SKS, SMT Goupil and EINA, plus Aion Tech UK retail introduction of Aurelia and Artemis. Release the initial qualified Aurelia/Artemis ranges and local platform editions. Live multi-brand document exchange, WordStar/dBASE on the assumed qualified licensed editions, Abacus/Pulse, peripheral compatibility and Team Edition demonstrations. Show BPI only on separately licensed and locally qualified configurations. Dealers can complete ranges with Logix or third-party products. Availability is configuration-specific; SGS full-portfolio qualification is not claimed. No shipment quantities are assigned by this event.
